verdicts.rationale: Milvus architecture supports search on 'growing segments' (recently inserted data not yet sealed) without requiring explicit collection load. The contract assertion 'collection is loaded' is incomplete - it should account for growing segments which are accessible via brute-force search by design. Source code confirms: 'If autoHandoff parameter is set false, Milvus simply searches the growing segments with brute force.' The API parameter 'ignoreGrowing' (default false) allows clients to control this behavior. This is intentional API design to support immediate query-after-insert patterns, not a defect.
